mandatoryQuestions: Is the wording legally accurate and non-misleading?
Are human-readable disclosures clear, accessible, perceivable and correctly timed?
Are translations materially equivalent across supported languages?
Is the 2 December 2026 transition restricted to qualifying pre-existing systems and the exact Article 50(2) duties covered by the final adopted act?
Are Article 50(1)/(2) provider duties and Article 50(3)/(4) deployer duties separated?
Does the product fail closed when Official Journal evidence is absent?
Do positive marking and disclosure claims require retained evidence references?
Can any browser payload select another organization or reference another tenant assessment?
Are the disclosure templates suitable only as starting points and not represented as universally sufficient legal copy?
Do status labels avoid certification, regulator-approval and guaranteed-compliance implications?
runtimeEvidenceRequired: proof that browser-local persistence is absent
limitations: This packet is preparation material and is not an accepted legal review.
Automated tests do not validate legal interpretation, translation equivalence, accessibility in a deployed UI or customer facts.
A submitted evidence record is not accepted evidence until reviewed by an authorized real person.
No staging, production, regulator or customer evidence is claimed by this packet.
